landing.heroParagraph: Unlike overlay widgets that lawsuits allege don't work, AccessGuard scans your actual code, generates AI-powered fixes, and integrates into your CI/CD pipeline.
landing.featuresSub: Overlay widgets are being challenged in court. Real code fixes are the only defensible approach.
landing.f1Desc: Our engine scans your actual rendered DOM, not just HTML snapshots. We detect violations other tools miss.
landing.f2Desc: Get AI-generated fix code for each violation. Our models are trained on WCAG patterns and real-world fixes.
landing.f3Desc: Prevent accessibility regressions before they reach production. Integrate scanning into your pipeline.
landing.f4Desc: Generate court-admissible PDF reports with cryptographic timestamps showing your good-faith remediation efforts.
landing.f5Desc: Track your accessibility score over time. Get alerted when new violations appear on your pages.
landing.f6Desc: Assign violations, track fixes, and generate PRs directly from our platform. Built for dev teams.
landing.testimonialsTitle: Trusted by teams who ship accessible products
landing.tm1Quote: AccessGuard caught 47 violations on our checkout flow before we shipped. The generated fix PRs saved our team weeks of manual work.
landing.tm2Quote: We passed our internal accessibility audit two weeks after switching to AccessGuard. The scheduled scans keep us compliant without any manual effort.
landing.tm3Quote: The compliance reports gave our legal team exactly what they needed to demonstrate good-faith remediation. Worth every penny.
landing.tm4Quote: Setup took five minutes. Our risk score went from 41 to 92 in the first month of using the auto-fix workflow.
landing.comparisonSub: See why developers choose real code fixes over JavaScript overlays
landing.ov1: Does not fix underlying source code
landing.ov6: No audit trail for legal defense
landing.pricingSub: Start free, scale as you grow. No hidden fees.
landing.pAgencyDesc: For digital agencies managing multiple clients
landing.faq1q: How does AccessGuard differ from overlay widgets?
landing.faq1a: Overlay widgets add a layer of JavaScript on top of your site to "fix" accessibility issues. Lawsuits allege they don't actually fix the underlying code. AccessGuard scans your actual source code, finds real violations, and generates concrete fixes you can deploy through your normal development workflow.
landing.faq2q: Do I need technical skills to use AccessGuard?
landing.faq2a: While AccessGuard is built for developers, our dashboard makes it easy for anyone to monitor compliance. Non-technical team members can track progress, generate reports, and manage violations through our intuitive interface.
landing.faq3q: How often should I scan my website?
landing.faq3a: We recommend scanning after every deployment and at least weekly for continuous monitoring. Our automated scheduling makes this effortless — set it once and we'll notify you of any new violations.
landing.faq4a: While no tool can guarantee lawsuit prevention, courts have consistently recognized good-faith remediation efforts. AccessGuard provides timestamped audit trails, generated fix PRs, and compliance reports that demonstrate your commitment to accessibility.
landing.faq5q: What WCAG standards do you support?
landing.faq5a: We currently support WCAG 2.1 Level A and AA standards, covering all success criteria. Our engine tests against actual user scenarios and browser rendering, not just static HTML analysis.
landing.faq6a: Yes. All scans are performed in isolated environments. Your source code never leaves our secure infrastructure. We're SOC 2 compliant and encrypt all data in transit and at rest.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to Make Your Site Accessible?
landing.ctaSub: Join hundreds of companies using AccessGuard to protect their business and make the web more accessible.
landing.privacyTitle: Your Code, Your Data, Your Control
landing.encDesc: All data encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3)
landing.encBody: Your source code and scan results are encrypted using industry-standard algorithms. We never share your data with third parties.
landing.socDesc: We undergo regular third-party security audits
landing.socBody: AccessGuard maintains SOC 2 Type II certification, ensuring our security controls meet the highest industry standards.
landing.gdprDesc: Full compliance with European data protection regulations
landing.gdprBody: We provide data processing agreements, data deletion APIs, and comply with GDPR requirements for data portability and right to erasure.
landing.tagline: Making the web accessible, one fix at a time.
